item.text: The implementation is under `store/_links`; the issue names a `services` path that does not exist yet. I’ll put the implementation at the requested path and keep the existing import path working through a re-export. The current parser can throw when `Media` or `Digests` is `null`, and exact chunk multiples currently get an extra zero block.

export * from '../../services/extendedAttributes';
EOF
cat > applications/drive/src/app/utils/type/DeepPartial.ts <<'EOF'
/** Makes every property of an object, including nested object properties, optional. */
export type DeepPartial<T> = T extends (infer Item)[]
    ? DeepPartial<Item>[]
    : T extends object
    ? { [Key in keyof T]?: DeepPartial<T[Key]> }
    : T;
EOF

# XAttr refactor checkpoint

Status: implementation in progress.

Next: update types and parsing, migrate callers/tests, run relevant existing tests and type check.
EOF'
